login.title: Log in
login.body: Log in with Google or LINE. The first time, we'll set up your profile (name, avatar, level) for you.

enter.title: Enter the court
enter.body: Tap a meetup from the home page, or scan the host's QR; enter the host's access code to get in.

play.title: Play / Queue
play.body: Tap an empty "+" slot on the court to go on; when it's full (4 players), tap "Queue" to wait. The timer starts once four players are set.

turn.title: Your turn
turn.body: You'll get a notification when it's your turn (install the app to your home screen to also get phone push). Tap the bell at the top right to see this session's notifications.

family.title: Bring family
family.body: Use "+ Add family" at the top to add family members who didn't bring a phone (enter a name, pick a cute avatar, set a level); once the host approves, you can queue them together with you.

vote.title: End by vote
vote.body: When all four are on court, tap "Vote to end this game"; once it reaches 2 votes it ends automatically and the next group goes on.

profile.title: Edit your profile
profile.body: Use "Settings" at the top right to change your name, default level, or avatar (pick a cute icon).
